item.title: Middle East Eye: Gaza death toll rises
item.description: Gaza death toll rises Hospitals in Gaza have recorded seven deaths over the past 48 hours, with one of those a person who succumbed to previous injuries, the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza reported. The ministry said 38 people were injured during the same period. Since the “ceasefire” in October 2025, Israel has killed 1,415 Palestinians in Gaza and injured 4,953. A total of 74,016 people have been killed since 7 October 2023, and 175,068 have been injured.

item.description: Israeli military attacks southern Lebanon areas with artillery fire Israeli forces have shelled al-Mansouri and Majdal Zoun areas in southern Lebanon’s Tyre district and Wadi Hassan, a valley on the outskirts of Majdal Zoun, the National News Agency reported. The forces also bombed the municipalities of Barashit and Haddatha in the Bint Jbeil district of the Nabatieh Governorate overnight. Israeli warplanes were also flying at low altitude over the city of Tyre and towns and villages in the…

item.title: Middle East Eye: UN expands list of companies operating in West Bank settlements
item.description: UN expands list of companies operating in West Bank settlements The United Nations human rights office issued a list on Friday adding 61 more companies operating in Israeli West Bank settlements, which are illegal under international law. The database is highly sensitive as firms could be targeted for boycotts or divestment to pressure Israel over settler expansion in the territory that is home to over three million Palestinians. The database, first released in 2020, now includes 214 firms…

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli forces storm West Bank towns, fire stun grenades at al-Am'ari refugee camp
item.description: Israeli forces storm West Bank towns, fire stun grenades at al-Am'ari refugee camp Israeli forces stormed the Qalandia refugee camp in the occupied West Bank, but there were no reports of immediate arrests, Wafa reported. They also raided the town of Kafr Aqab in north Jerusalem, and fired stun grenades at al-Am'ari refugee camp during a raid on el-Bireh, according to the report.
